scope: Explicitly authorized domain tracker adapter, lifecycle and bounded measurement histories; preview consumes shared adapter

implementation.adapter: ByteTrackAdapter; per-class pinned CPU ByteTrack; explicit low floor; original observation-index mapping
implementation.identity_format: namespace/epoch/class_id/backend_id; source ID in identity metadata
implementation.history: Only confirmed measurements, bounded by count and source age; current continuity segment; no decoded images or predictions
implementation.lifecycle: Observed/lost snapshots; source-time expiry; reset events; gap reacquisition clears history and increments segment
implementation.pre_mutation_rejection: Invalid same-source index/time ordering, detection/frame mismatch, index/dimension/class types, mutable coordinates
implementation.backend_failure: Raises and invalidates partial epoch; caller records failure; subsequent updates start fresh
implementation.preview_jsonl: Each original observation once with ID/segment; per-track lifecycle and retention summaries; no repeated full-history serialization

checks.hosted_ci: not run; adapter integration suite added to required CPU workflow

limitations: No reference identity accuracy, IDF1/HOTA, unique-object counts or generalization claim.
Only confirmed observations enter history; tentative measurements are not backfilled.
IDs are hypotheses; a silent backend identity switch can remain undetected.
Retention limits apply per live domain track; clients retaining old snapshots own extra memory.
No full detection-plus-tracking orchestration or matched end-to-end throughput acceptance.
No motion, TTC, metric range or warning estimator.
Historical milestone-1/preview evidence preserves earlier code hashes and output schemas.
